label: Spotify Ads (Spotify Ads Manager)
terms_note: Spotify for Developers app with Ads API access (application / approval) + Ads Manager account authorization (OAuth2); versioned URIs (integer prefix; v2 sunset 2025-08-05, v3 current); 'Rate limiting caps the number of API calls … 50 requests per second per client ID + user ID' with stricter reporting caps. Free.

discovery.auth: oauth2 (Spotify for Developers app + Ads Manager account; authorization code)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (Spotify Ads API v3) Confidence: **high** — official docs read.
auth: 1. Create an app on developer.spotify.com and request Ads API access (application); complete Ads Manager account prerequisites.
2. OAuth 2.0 authorization code with the Ads Manager user → access + refresh tokens.

endpoints.purpose: campaigns (objective CLICKS / VIDEO_VIEWS / PODCAST_STREAMS / WEB_TRAFFIC / APP_INSTALLS)
ad sets: placements MUSIC / PODCAST, targeting, budget, schedule, bid
endpoints.notes: campaign_id, placements[], targeting{geo, age, gender, interests, audiences}, budget, start/end, bid
asset upload, ad_set_id, asset ids, cta, click_url

reference.limits: - 50 requests/second per client ID + user ID; reporting endpoints have specialized caps; Ads API application approval; free.

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: Client ID of your Spotify for Developers app registered for the Ads API (the Ads API Terms must be accepted for it; allowlisting can take an hour).

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: The app's client secret (HTTP Basic on https://accounts.spotify.com/api/token).

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: Refresh token from one authorization-code login with your Ads Manager account (https://developer.spotify.com/documentation/ads-api/quick-start); it does not expire. One-hour access tokens are minted from it.

config_fields.name: business_id
config_fields.help: Spotify Ads business id whose ad accounts list_accounts returns (GET /businesses lists yours).

config_fields.name: ad_account_id
config_fields.help: Ad account id used by pause_resume (the campaign PATCH path is /ad_accounts/{ad_account_id}/campaigns/{campaign_id}).

me.note: GET /ads/v3/businesses: the businesses of the logged-in user ({businesses: [{id, name, type, status}]}).

list_accounts.note: GET /ads/v3/businesses/{business_id config}/ad_accounts: ad accounts under the business for the current user (currency_code, status, ad_account_role).

list_campaigns.note: GET /ads/v3/ad_accounts/{ad_account_id}/campaigns (limit up to 50, offset; `status` filters statuses: ACTIVE, PAUSED, ARCHIVED…). Budgets live on ad sets (budget.micro_amount), not campaigns.

get_report.note: GET /ads/v3/ad_accounts/{ad_account_id}/aggregate_reports?entity_type=CAMPAIGN&granularity=LIFETIME&fields=IMPRESSIONS&fields=CLICKS&fields=SPEND with report_start/report_end at UTC midnight (range within 90 days): one row per campaign whose `stats` is a list of {field_type, field_value} (SPEND in the account currency). campaign_id is not applied; first page only (continuation_token).

pause_resume.note: PATCH /ads/v3/ad_accounts/{ad_account_id config}/campaigns/{campaign_id} {status: PAUSED|ACTIVE}. Resuming restarts spending.

not_offered.update_budget: Spotify budgets are set per ad set in micros ("budget.micro_amount: Total budget for the ad set multiplied by x10 to the 6th power", https://developer.spotify.com/documentation/ads-api/reference/v3.0/updateAdSet); campaigns carry no budget and the adapter cannot scale to micros.

evidence: host api-partner.spotify.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (DigiCert Inc)
probe: 5/5 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route answered 401 too, so the host authenticates before routing
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 5/5 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
